repos.name: mikehasa/agentacct
repos.description: See what your coding agents did and what it cost. Breaks each task down into work steps — tools used, files changed, tests run, time and tokens spent. Local-first dashboard for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more. No login, no telemetry.
repos.one_liner: A local-first observability dashboard for tracking the performance, token usage, and cost of coding agents.
bullets: Built with Python, providing a local-first dashboard to monitor agent activity.
Integrates with tools like Claude Code and Codex to track work steps, file changes, and test execution.
Provides granular cost analysis by breaking down token consumption and time spent per task.
Ideal for finance and engineering teams looking to audit and optimize AI-driven development workflows.
repos.img_alt: agentacct tui — live usage, cost, provider rate-limit bars, and recent sessions with per-session weekly-plan-cost estimates
repos.img2_alt: agentacct tui session detail — the per-step work ledger with pass/fail check evidence and a weekly-plan-cost estimate

repos.name: simonlin1212/vibe-astock
repos.description: A 股短线复盘看板：涨停池·连板梯队·龙虎榜·板块资金一屏看完，赚钱效应/晋级率/梯队断层/情绪周期等派生指标纯计算直出（不经过 AI），AI 只把数据串成能读的盘面研判。全本地运行，可用 Claude/Codex 订阅免 API key。| A-share short-term daily-review dashboard: derived sentiment metrics computed locally, AI only writes the narrative. No API key needed.
repos.one_liner: A local-first A-share market sentiment and short-term trading dashboard that combines deterministic metrics with AI analysis.
bullets: Uses a Python-based stack to compute market sentiment metrics like limit-up pools and sector capital flow.
Employs a hybrid approach: deterministic math for core financial indicators and AI for narrative synthesis.
Supports local execution with Claude/Codex, allowing for private analysis without external API dependencies.
Designed for quantitative traders to visualize market 'money effect' and sentiment cycles in real-time.

repos.name: EthanXiang777/circuit-framework
repos.description: Circuit Framework — multi-agent LLM trading research system
repos.one_liner: A multi-agent LLM framework specifically designed for automated trading research and strategy development.
bullets: Python-based multi-agent architecture designed to orchestrate complex financial research tasks.
Focuses on automating the lifecycle of trading strategy development from hypothesis to validation.
Enables modular agent interaction to handle data ingestion, signal generation, and backtesting.
Targeted at quantitative researchers building autonomous systems for financial market analysis.
